intended_claim: The preset top-1/top-2 counterfactual opportunity is sufficient to continue the current configured constructive learning branch.
what_results_support: The executed fixed training-sample opportunity gate fails: 23/144 material improvements (15.9722%) is below 20%; local 5/48 (10.4167%) is below 15%.
There are real conditional full-route cost differences under the same frozen continuation and common H; 33 improvements, 76 ties and 35 degradations were independently recovered from CSV.
Closing this configured opportunity branch and revisiting planning-decision design is consistent with the predeclared decision rule.
what_results_dont_support: Oracle mean 0.5217912% is not learned-policy improvement, a learned selector's return, optimal Q, or additive gains along a route.
The result does not establish impossibility for all constructive planning or all DRL methods.
No independent-layout generalization, equal-cache deployment speedup, online committed-prefix value, physical IK or joint-trajectory claim is established.
missing_evidence: Learned-selector performance and independent-layout generalization are absent and would be needed only for broader future claims.
The reviewer verified the shared H entry point and archive work counts; the underlying terminal source/hash binding was supplied separately by the main thread rather than independently reopened.
The supplied 843.293-second resource snapshot requires final all-inclusive delivery closure by the main thread.

The configured branch did not meet the criterion for further learning work.
next_experiments_note: None needed or authorized to decide this executed gate. Future design and execution require a separate protocol, implementation review and authorization; do not auto-run PG/Q/multiseed or another reward baseline.
